http_api.ownerSymbol: UiRuntime server semantic GET/SSE and observation GET routes
http_api.contract: The observation route parses optionalI2ReadScope, the scope subtree, node selection and decodeTaskAgentActivitySelectionQuery, then calls UiRuntimeService.scopedObservation.

load_task_truth.contract: The shared resolver selects the serve-bound live source or the declared project/mode durable inventory. Foreign admissions come from that inventory, not the serve-bound requirementAdmissions map. The verified controlRecords are the only source used to decode and replay task/owner assignment graph facts; a missing graph stream remains explicit missing recorded history.

project_semantic_views.contract: The existing RuntimeAgentActivityProjection.actualExecutionGraph field carries the source TaskActualExecutionGraphSnapshot through the UI source-to-view helper. Guidance, current plan and recorded instances stay distinct; parent and membership facts are never promoted to dependencies.

project_status_and_actions.contract: UiRuntimeService builds node facts before this projection. task.output is projected only from authoritative committed public publication; missing publication is explicit and raw execution evidence is not presented as final output.

browser_view.ownerSymbol: shared semantic observation panel scope and finite-stream handling
browser_view.contract: The UI-owned api.observation fifth parameter carries the complete taskScope projectKey/mode. The existing scope query remains the observation subtree and node remains the selected node; the agent query keeps the existing decoder. Both formal pages consume the same agentActivity read and actualExecutionGraph carrier without a second fetch.
